text:
ingrid (partnerships): Ok team — Helios granted marketplace sandbox access under NDA v3. Need a short handoff checklist so we can ship images + perf targets to their lab. cc @kevin for legal and @ana for infra. Link to workspace: https://drive.redwood/helios/sandbox (internal)

tj (solutions): Awesome. Plan to run 3 suites: latency, throughput, memory. Start with 8k context, int8 quant, q4_0 fallback. Keep single-client and multi-client runs.

ana (eng-infra): I reserved a dev2 test pool in us-west-2. Need the container image, model artifact tarball, and a sha256. Also any special kernel flags.

ingrid (partnerships): Quick action list I want tracked here:
1) Legal: confirm NDA telemetry + retention clause — @kevin
2) Infra: prep image + runbook for sandbox ops — @ana
3) ML: baseline prompt set + regression evals — @s-reed
4) Solutions/PM: joint comms window & embargo plan — @tj

kevin (legal): Scanned NDA v3 — small telemetry retention tweak that needs to be explicit. I'll send a redline by EOD. No blockers otherwise.

s-reed (eng-ml): I'll assemble the bench harness and the prompt/regression set. Also propose adding a warm-KV cache scenario and cold-start run. Expect to capture p50/p90/p99 and token-level breakdowns.

ana (eng-infra): Ops notes for the handoff:
```
# deploy to Helios sandbox
./deploy.sh --env=helios-sandbox --pool=dev2 --image=redwood/helios-2026:sha256-xxxx
# collect perf
./perf/collect.sh --suites latency,throughput,memory --out=/artifacts/helios
```
I'll open SSH access to the lab hosts and create a `helios-sandbox` service account.

partners-bot: Helios sandbox token created: token-XXXX-EXAMPLE (expires in 7d). Access granted to: ingrid, tj, ana, s-reed.

tj (solutions): Comms: no public announcement yet. Draft joint blog + customer quote plan 4 weeks after we validate metrics. Need legal and partner marketing approvals.

ingrid (partnerships): Please drop ETAs in thread so I can compile the handoff doc. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 10:00am PT to walk through the runbook.

ana (eng-infra): Image + runbook uploaded to the Helios folder by Wed 18:00 PT.

s-reed (eng-ml): Bench harness + prompts by Wed 21:00 PT. Will include scripts to produce p50/p90/p99 and token-cost CSV.

kevin (legal): NDA redline posted by EOD; call out on telemetry retention window (30 -> 90 days) is my note.

tj (solutions): Draft comms timeline in the doc by Thu 09:00 PT.

ingrid (partnerships): Perfect — I'll consolidate and post a final checklist + calendar invite. :rocket:
